# The library surface (#940): every module of src/lib.rs with its tier. `docs/reference/api.md`
# explains the tiers and lists the curated items; tests/library_surface.rs keeps the three in step.
#
#   curated  `pub`; the items api.md lists for it are covered by the semver promise, the rest of
#            the module is not and is narrowed module by module
#   queued   `pub` only because the binaries, the integration tests or Studio import from it; not
#            covered, to be narrowed or `#[doc(hidden)]` in a later slice
#   crate    `pub(crate)`; no consumer outside the crate
#
# A new module is `pub(crate)` unless it is deliberately added here as `curated`. `queued` is not
# a place to put new modules: its count may only fall (QUEUED_CEILING in the test).
a11y_journey queued
